note: probe-training mechanics, not economic hyperparameters; frozen before any probe-score is seen

adapter_fitting_P1.adapter_train_val_split: probe_fit block split causally: oldest 70% adapter-train, purge max(horizons)=12 steps, newest remainder adapter-val; probe-score untouched until final scoring
adapter_fitting_P1.best_state: checkpoint and restore the best adapter by adapter-val loss
adapter_fitting_P1.finite_curves: every train/val loss finite, else probe refusal
adapter_fitting_P1.minimum_improvement: best adapter-val loss <= 0.99 x initial-adapter val loss (1% declared), else ADAPTER_FAILED_TO_FIT -> probe refusal
adapter_fitting_P1.aggregation: median probe-score across the three seeds; dispersion = max - min
adapter_fitting_P1.seed_instability_refusal: (max - min) / |median| > 0.5 -> MATERIAL_SEED_INSTABILITY -> probe refusal (never select the best seed)

references.random: untrained strong-architecture encoder (fixed construction seed 0) = neutral floor (skill 0)
references.solo: existing solo specialist encoders = diagnostic ceilings (skill 1), NOT an eligibility gate

neutral_skill_P2.skill_formula: (loss_random - loss_route) / (loss_random - loss_solo), computed per probe per family on seed-median losses
neutral_skill_P2.denominator_refusal: loss_solo >= loss_random (ill-ordered) OR denominator < 0.05 x loss_random (near-zero) -> that probe is DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID for ranking (raw losses preserved and reported)
neutral_skill_P2.worse_than_random: median skill < -0.05 on a predictive probe (quantile/volatility/barrier) = materially worse than random
ranking_per_family: 1) eligibility: NO predictive probe materially worse than random across adapter seeds
2) maximize median normalized skill across quantile+volatility+barrier
3) then median skill across all five probes
neutral_skill_P2.diagnostics: reconstruction and contrastive remain representation diagnostics; the three forward probes lead
neutral_skill_P2.fallback: a family with every route worse than random on a predictive probe takes full5 as the CONSERVATIVE DIAGNOSTIC candidate, never labeled proven-optimal

P3_identity_rule: routes are NOT retrained; the existing R5 route/solo training identities are reused verbatim (their run manifests and encoder digests bind the identities)
